CONTROLS.NAME: pulsing_fire
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Audio reactive pulses. Turn OFF for constant motion.

CONTROLS.NAME: bass_travel
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Zoom in on bass hits, creating a feeling of moving forwards.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_color_only
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This lets you use the media color only, instead of mixing with the fire.

CONTROLS.NAME: multiply_color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, multiplies the media and fire color, otherwise it is additive.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_refract
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Affects how distorted the media is.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_palette
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 4 color palettes to choose from on one slider.

CONTROLS.NAME: glassy_surface
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates a smooth glassy surface. Tipping point is around 70%.

CONTROLS.NAME: scan_lines
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses vertical scan lines out from the center.

CONTROLS.NAME: ring_of_fire
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Spawns a slow moving ring of fire moving out from the center.

CONTROLS.NAME: darken
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse of darkness across the screen, with fire returning shortly afer.

CONTROLS.NAME: fireworks
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates quick burst effects in each cell of the fire.

CONTROLS.NAME: reset_sim
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Only used to reset the simulation if it entirely dies.

DESCRIPTION: A flaming dynamical system. Click to interact, press spacebar to reset.
TITLE: Dynamical Flame
